name: Bog Hound

abilities.name: Mire Lurk
abilities.description: While the bog hound is in swamp terrain or wading water, the bog hound has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made there, and a creature that has not seen it move has disadvantage on Perception checks to spot it there.

abilities.name: Whelm (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The bog hound whelms one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While whelmed, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the bog hound, and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the bog hound's turns. The bog hound can have only one creature whelmed at a time. If the bog hound takes 5 damage or more in a single turn from the whelmed creature, the bog hound must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the bog hound. If the bog hound dies, a whelmed creature pulls free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bog hound makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Muck Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
